newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Eletrobras to build transmission line.
newsitem.headline: Eletrobras to build transmission line.

text.p: Brazilian state-owned power holding Eletrobras said it will start buying construction equipment on Monday for its $738 million transmission line project that will link the country's north and south generating units.
The transmission line will link Imperatriz power station in the northeastern state of Maranhao to Samambaia station in the federal district of Brasilia, it said.
The construction is expected to be completed in December 1998 and will allow Eletrobras to transfer 1,000 megawatts of electricity.
"This will help to improve the quality of energy supplied by that power systems, which are responsible for 98 percent of the country's electricity consumption," it said.
Eletrobras plans to finance the project with loans from the Interamerican Development Bank and Japan's Eximbank, it added.
